lines.cap: In 1910, six of America's most powerful men boarded a private train using first names only. They said they were going duck hunting.
lines.say: In 1910, six of America's most powerful men boarded a private train using first names only. They said they were going duck hunting.

lines.cap: It left at night. Reporters weren't told. Even the staff didn't know who they were.
lines.say: It left at night. Reporters weren't told. Even the staff didn't know who they were.

lines.cap: A senator, Nelson Aldrich. And top bankers from the biggest banks in the country.
lines.say: A senator, Nelson Aldrich. And top bankers from the biggest banks in the country.

lines.cap: They went to the Jekyll Island Club in Georgia. A private island for millionaires, opened just for them.
lines.say: They went to the Jekyll Island Club in Georgia. A private island for millionaires, opened just for them.

lines.cap: For about nine days, they didn't hunt ducks. They wrote a plan for a new central bank for America.
lines.say: For about nine days, they didn't hunt ducks. They wrote a plan for a new central bank for America.

lines.cap: Three years later, a version of their plan became law. The Federal Reserve. It still controls America's money today.
lines.say: Three years later, a version of their plan became law. The Federal Reserve. It still controls America's money today.

lines.cap: For years they denied it. Decades later, one of them admitted it in a magazine. Yes, it was secret. Yes, it happened.
lines.say: For years they denied it. Decades later, one of them admitted it in a magazine. Yes, it was secret. Yes, it happened.
